summary: Complaints centre on urea and fertiliser shortages with long cooperative queues at Baghra, unpaid sugarcane dues across the district, and fatal crashes on the Baghra bypass of the Panipat-Khatima highway; appreciation is not backed by any source found.

positives.english: *Highway access makes it easy to reach mandis and towns from Baghra
positives.hindi: *पानीपत-खटीमा हाईवे पास होने से बघरा से मंडी और शहर तक जाना आसान है
positives.basis: Inference: no source found on voters' views of roads or access. The Panipat-Khatima highway runs past the Baghra bypass (Amar Ujala, 2025-10-01, see negative 4), so access is a plausible strength but is unverified.

positives.english: *Sugarcane is a cash crop here, and mills in the area take it
positives.hindi: *गन्ने की फसल से नकदी मिलती है, और इलाके की मिलें गन्ना खरीदती हैं
positives.basis: Inference: sugarcane is the main cash crop in the district (Amar Ujala, 2025-12-05, district-level), but no source says voters see it as a positive. Dues are a complaint (negative 2).

positives.english: *The cooperative committee at Baghra still supplies fertiliser to farmers
positives.hindi: *बघरा की सहकारी समिति से खाद मिलने का सहारा अब भी है
positives.basis: Inference: the Baghra committee is a working distribution point (Amar Ujala, 2025-06-27 and 2025-07-04), and its supply is also the main complaint (negative 1 and 3). Value as a positive is unverified.

positives.english: *Charthawal's market towns give daily essentials close to home
positives.hindi: *चरथावल कस्बे के बाजार में रोजमर्रा का सामान पास में मिल जाता है
positives.basis: Inference: Charthawal is a Nagar Panchayat and development block (Wikipedia, Charthawal Assembly constituency). No source on market access was found.

positives.english: *Villagers still help each other in a crisis
positives.hindi: *गांव में मुसीबत के वक्त लोग एक-दूसरे की मदद को आगे आते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: generic rural positive, not drawn from any source. Field check needed.

negatives.english: Urea is hard to get at Baghra, and farmers go home empty-handed
negatives.hindi: बघरा में यूरिया नहीं मिलती, किसान खाली हाथ लौटते हैं
negatives.basis: AC-specific. Amar Ujala video report (Dimple Sirohi, 27 Jun 2025) describes a ruckus at Sadhan Sahkari Samiti, Baghra, where farmers from six nearby villages returned without urea and said they are routinely told to come back the next day. Farmers' allegation of unfair distribution is their claim, not verified.

negatives.english: Sugarcane dues are still stuck with the mills, and the price is too low
negatives.hindi: गन्ने का बकाया मिलों पर अटका है, और भाव भी कम है
negatives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific. Amar Ujala (Muzaffarnagar dateline, 5 Dec 2025) reports SP MP Harendra Malik told the Lok Sabha that Bajaj Group's 14 mills owe farmers more than 100 crore rupees, and that the cane price is inadequate.

negatives.english: At Baghra, fertiliser queues form early and staff arrive late
negatives.hindi: बघरा की समिति पर खाद के लिए सुबह से कतार लगती है, कर्मचारी देर से आते हैं
negatives.basis: AC-specific. Amar Ujala video report (Dimple Sirohi, 4 Jul 2025) says a long queue formed at the Bagra cooperative committee on the Panipat-Khatima highway before staff arrived, and distribution began only in the afternoon. Farmers' complaint, quoted from villagers.

negatives.english: The Baghra bypass on the Panipat-Khatima highway is deadly, six died in one crash
negatives.hindi: बघरा बाईपास पर हाईवे खतरनाक है, हाल में एक हादसे में छह लोगों की मौत हुई
negatives.basis: AC-specific location. Amar Ujala (1 Oct 2025) reports a car ran into a truck parked at a dhaba on the Baghra bypass of the Panipat-Khatima highway; six people from one family died and one was injured. Headline names the family as from Karnal.

negatives.english: *Stray cattle eat the crop and farmers cannot protect their fields
negatives.hindi: *आवारा पशु फसल खा जाते हैं, खेत की रखवाली मुश्किल है
negatives.basis: Inference: stray cattle is a common farm complaint in western UP, but no source specific to Charthawal or Muzaffarnagar was fetched. Field check needed.

notes: Identity confirmed from the Wikipedia page: AC 12, Charthawal, Muzaffarnagar district, reserved status None (SC-reserved 1967-2008), current MLA Pankaj Kumar Malik (SP, 2022). The Assembly factbook PDF could not be read (scanned, no text). Wikipedia lists local place names including Baghra, Charthawal (Nagar Panchayat), Kutesra, Dhindhawali, Nara, Jarauda, Bahadarpur, Lachheda, Sujru, Bihari, Harsauli, Tawli, Simli, Vahalana, Nirmana, and Barwala (Kukra). Only Baghra has AC-specific complaints found: fertiliser shortage and queues (2025) and the bypass crash (2025). Charthawal town, Kutesra, and Dhindhawali yielded no local issues. Positives are all unsourced inferences and need a field check. Negative 5 (stray cattle) is unsourced. Sugarcane dues (negative 2) are district-level. A Wikipedia snippet also conflicts with another source on whether Noor Saleem Rana or Pankaj Malik held the seat in 2012-17. This was not used. Search quota ran out after about 17 searches, and the Lok Sabha reply on eparlib.nic.in was unreachable, so the research is thin. A follow-up with Hindi local searches (Amar Ujala and Dainik Jagran Muzaffarnagar, Kutesra, Dhindhawali, nearest sugar mill names) is recommended.
